in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is victorious (Vijayi) and full of power (Shakti)

in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who is full of strength and power (Vajanamataak Vijayi and Shakti)

in_tamil.name: தெக்ராம்
in_tamil.long_meaning: He who is victorious (Vijayathmaa) or She who is full of power (Saktiyaal)

in_telugu.name: టెక్రామ్
in_telugu.long_meaning: He who is full of life (Jeevithyapoeyedu) and abundant with power (Ayyahy Shakti)

in_marathi.name: Tekram
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Time
in_marathi.long_meaning: Tekram हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Tekram is derived from the Sanskrit language and is a compound of two words 'Te' which means 'Time' and 'Kram' which means 'God'. The name Tekram represents the God of Time and is believed to bring strength, power, and bravery. This name is perfect for a boy who is destined for great things and is expected to leave a lasting impact on the world.
